from hermes_tools import write_file
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u015/system/state/workspace/programs/task-23106606.py'
s='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Remove the scattered background marks; retain outlined rectangular frames.
    frames=[]
    for color in range(1,10):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        # A frame is solid along all four bounding edges.
        if all(g[r0][c]==color and g[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[r][c0]==color and g[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            frames.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,color))
    # Identify scattered marker colors associated with frames by their local abundance/nearest frame.
    scattered=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,) and not any(r in (a,b) or c in (x,y) for a,b,x,y,_ in frames)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not any((r in (a,b) and x<=c<=y) or (c in (x,y) and a<=r<=b) for a,b,x,y,_ in frames):
                if g[r][c] not in [f[4] for f in frames]: g[r][c]=0
    # For each frame, choose the external marker color nearest to it (excluding frame colors).
    for a,b,x,y,col in frames:
        candidates=[]
        for sr,sc,mc in scattered:
            if mc==col: continue
            d=min(abs(sr-a),abs(sr-b),abs(sc-x),abs(sc-y))
            candidates.append((d,mc))
        if candidates:
            # Prefer the most common external marker color when distances tie.
            from collections import Counter
            counts=Counter(mc for _,_,mc in scattered)
            mind=min(d for d,_ in candidates)
            marker=max((mc for d,mc in candidates if d==mind),key=lambda m:counts[m])
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                for c in range(x+1,y):
                    g[r][c]=marker if (r-a-1+c-x-1)%2==0 else 0
    return g
'''
print(write_file(p,s))
